en: A monochrome postcard showing a large medieval cathedral complex with multiple tall towers. Two slender Gothic spires with pinnacles stand at the western end, while two more massive, rounded Romanesque towers with domed tops rise behind them. In front is a long building with a steep roof and rows of small windows. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style German text identifies the scene.
